# Workflow audit

## Goal
Find which steps of your process are worth automating first, judged by effort against impact.

Plan followed:
1. Restate the process step by step
2. Score each step for effort and impact
3. Rank the opportunities
4. Recommend the first one to automate

## Process as understood
1. Customer emails an order
2. Staff manually copies it into a spreadsheet
3. Manager approves by message
4. Staff emails the customer a confirmation

| Rank | Step | Impact | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Staff manually copies it into a spreadsheet | High | Low |
| 2 | Customer emails an order | High | Medium |
| 3 | Staff emails the customer a confirmation | Medium | Medium |
| 4 | Manager approves by message | Low | Medium |

Scores come from keywords in your description (manual copying, phone work and spreadsheets raise impact; approvals and judgment raise effort). Treat them as a first pass to confirm with the people who do the work.
